relations.subject: Awadh Kishore Narain
relations.role: Professor of History and South Asian Studies, Chair of the Buddhist Studies Program
relations.evidence: In 1971, he was appointed Professor of History and South Asian Studies at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, USA, where he was also the Chair of the Buddhist Studies Program. In 1987, Narain was granted early retirement

relations.subject: Awadh Kishore Narain
